_comment: OpenClaw command descriptor for Tier 1 local image generation through ComfyUI.
name: generate_image
description: Generate a still image, hero background, concept frame, thumbnail, or product visual through the local ComfyUI image workflow.
trigger_examples: make a hero image for the estate landing page
generate a dark luxury thumbnail for this fragrance
create a concept frame for the car showroom

name.description: Output base name, e.g. estate-hero or crushed-thumbnail

prompt.description: Full visual prompt to pass to ComfyUI

returns: Relay the line beginning IMAGE_RESULT_JSON= back to the user.
notes: Publishing generated images is a separate approval-gated step unless the user explicitly requested local-only generation.
